name: HZ_GEO_HIERARCHY_CF
description: The HZ_GEO_HIERARCHY_CF table contains geography hierarchies in ten level of column-flattened structure.

columns.name: HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
columns.description: Unique hierarchy node identifier.

columns.name: HIERARCHY_TYPE
columns.description: The hierarchy type name (i.e. MASTER_REF or TM)

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if this hierarchy is active. A if it is active and I if it is inactive.

columns.name: BASE_GEO_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of lowest level geography (Foreign key to HZ_GEOGRAPHIES.GEOGRAPHY_ID)

columns.name: BASE_GEO_NAME
columns.description: Name of lowest level geography

columns.name: BASE_GEO_CODE
columns.description: Code of the lowest level geography

columns.name: LEAF_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the base geography is a leaf. Y if it is the lowest level, otherwise N.

columns.name: FIXED_HIER_LEVEL
columns.description: Stores the number of level that the node is fixed. For a 10 level hierarchy, the top node has 9. The base has 0 as value for this attribute.
